question: For each US state, is FY24 SLED grant flow proportional to health-outcome burden (PLACES) per capita?

matches.note: F1 grants (FY25-26). FY24 comes from flow #3.

internal_scan.verdict: PLACES exists (F2). FY24 grants exist from flow #3. This flow pulls PLACES fresh and joins by state at build time to a fresh USASpending FY24 aggregate — republishing an equity-scored view. Direct grant OUTCOMES are not available (canonical pass-3 substitution).

candidates.source: USASpending POST spending_by_award (FY24 SLED, aggregated by state)
CDC PLACES 2023 chronicdata.cdc.gov swc5-untb, filtered to categoryid=HLTHOUT

preference_order_rule: PROXY substitution is explicit: outcomes → burden. INTERNAL first (PLACES exists); external pull for FY24 SLED aggregate at state level.
gap_summary: F0 direct per-grant OUTCOME data is not publicly available at scale — this flow substitutes CDC PLACES health-outcomes as a NEED proxy. 'Equity ratio' surfaces DOLLARS-PER-NEED, not any normative determination about grant effectiveness.
